title: Materials and Processes
description: Materials and Processes as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Are candidate materials identified for each item?
Are material compatibility risks (fluids, galvanic, temperature) identified?
Environmental Impact and Sustainability: are restricted or hazardous substances identified for avoidance?
Are materials and processes selected from approved specifications?
Are design allowables available for the selected materials?
Are finishes and protective treatments compatible with the materials?
Environmental Impact and Sustainability: are restricted substances avoided in all finishes?
Are material and process specifications called up on every released definition?
Are material qualification and test needs met or planned?

draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.
